052import javax.swing.InputMap;

054import javax.swing.SpinnerModel;

061
062import dev.visdb.seesaw.navigate.RowsActions.NavGotoRowAction;

064
065import static dev.visdb.seesaw.navigate.Utils.getGlobalEventBus;
066import static dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.JStuff.sf;
067import static dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.SsUtils.isJunitPrint;
068import static java.awt.event.KeyEvent.VK_DOWN;
069import static java.awt.event.KeyEvent.VK_UP;

073/**
074 * A {@code JSpinner} for {@linkplain javax.sql.RowSet}'s row number;
075 * the {@code JSpinner} is associated with a {@code RowsModel}.
076 * The {@code JSpinner} uses a {@code SpinnerNumberModel} which tracks
077 * the {@code RowsModel}'s {@code ResultSet}'s current row and its limits.
078 * <p>
079 * There are some methods for configuring this Spinner:
080 * <ul>
081 * <li>{@link #removeTinyArrows(java.awt.Dimension)}
082 * <li>{@link #setWindowUpDownKeysEnable(boolean) }
083 * <li>{@link #setUpDownKeysEnable(boolean) }
084 * </ul>
085 * These methods are accessible through {@link dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.SsDataNavigator} methods.
086 * <p>
087 * There's a Spinner API tweak such that {@code setModel()}
088 * sends a {@code ChangeEvent}. This is convenient when considering the spinner
089 * as part of a navigator and {@code RowsModel.setRowSet()}.
090 */
091@SuppressWarnings("serial")
092public class RowNumberSpinner extends JSpinner {
093  private static final Logger logger = JStuff.getLogger();
094  //private NavGotoRowAction gotoRowAction;
095  private RowsModel rowsModel;
096
097  /**
098   * Construct spinner for row number in a data navigator.
099   * @param rowsModel
100   */
101  public RowNumberSpinner(RowsModel rowsModel) {
102    this.rowsModel = rowsModel;
103    busReceiver = new BusReceiver();
104    WeakEventBus.register(busReceiver, getGlobalEventBus());
105
106    setAction();
107  }
108
109  BusReceiver busReceiver; // Must have a strong reference.
110  class BusReceiver {
111    // Each RowSet has it's own SpinnerModel.
112    // Need to note model change to update spinner, no gain in wrapping spinner model.
113    @WeakSubscribe
114    @SuppressWarnings("UseOfSystemOutOrSystemErr")
115    public void handleNewRowSetEvent(RowsModelNewRowSetEvent ev) {
116      if (ev.getRowsModel() != rowsModel)
117        return;
118      if (isJunitPrint())
119        System.err.printf("RowNumberSpinner: %s\n", ev.toString());
120      else
121        logger.log(DEBUG, () -> sf("Change spinner rowSet/model %s", ev.toString()));
122      internalChangeSpinnerModel();
123    }
124  }
125
126  /** {@inheritDoc} */
127  @Override
128  public SpinnerNumberModel getModel() {
129    return (SpinnerNumberModel) super.getModel();
130  }
131
132  private boolean actionSetModel;
133  /**
134   * {@inheritDoc}
135   *
136   * <b>An exception is thrown if invoked unexpectedly.</b>
137   */
138  @Override
139  public void setModel(SpinnerModel model) {
140    if (!actionSetModel)
141      throw new IllegalCallerException("Can not change the model");
142    super.setModel(model);
143  }
144
145  /** Use this to track enabled. */
146  private final PropertyChangeListener pclEnableDisableAction = (evt) -> {
147    if ("enabled".equals(evt.getPropertyName()))
148      setEnabled((boolean) evt.getNewValue());
149  };
150
151  /** forward spinner events to goto row action */
152  private final ChangeListener changeListener = (evt) -> {
153    if (rowsModel.getRowSet() == null)
154      return;
155    // This has problems with Example 4, nav combo not updating fields.
156    // rowsModel.getAction(RowsAction.ACT_GOTOROW)
157    //      .actionPerformed(new ActionEvent(RowNumberSpinner.this,
158    //      AWTEvent.RESERVED_ID_MAX + 1, RowsAction.OK_SKIP_CURSOR_MOVE));
159    Action act = rowsModel.getAction(RowsAction.ACT_GOTOROW);
160    // if (!act.isEnabled()) {
161    //  return;
162    // }
163    act.actionPerformed(null);
164  };
165
166  private void internalChangeSpinnerModel() {
167    // If JSpinner setModel doesn't come from right here,
168    // an exception is thrown.
169    actionSetModel = true;
170    try {
171      if (rowsModel.getRowSet() == null)
172        setModel(new SpinnerNumberModel());
173      else
174        setModel(rowsModel.getRowNumberModel());
175      fireStateChanged(); // Treat a model change as a state change
176    } finally {
177      actionSetModel = false;
178    }
179  }
180
181  /**
182   * Listen to the specified action for Spinner enabled; send events to it.
183   * The action contains the model for the JSpinner.
184   * @param action provides enabled
185   */
186  private void setAction() {
187    Action action = rowsModel.getAction(RowsAction.ACT_GOTOROW);
188
189    if (!(action instanceof NavGotoRowAction gotoRowAction))
190      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Must be NavGotoRowAction");
191
192    removeChangeListener(changeListener);
193
194    internalChangeSpinnerModel();
195
196    // Copy the enable/disable state.
197    setEnabled(gotoRowAction.isEnabled());
198
199    // Listen to the gotoAction for enable/disable Spinner.
200    gotoRowAction.addPropertyChangeListener(pclEnableDisableAction);
201
202    // Forward JSpinner events through the action.
203    addChangeListener(changeListener);
204  }
205
206  /**
207   * Customize the spinner to get rid of the tiny spinner up/down arrows. There's also example code to disable/enable the keyboard up/down arrows.
208   * @param targetSpinnerSize used to set the width after removing the arrows
209   */
210  //https://stackoverflow.com/questions/16284594/disable-up-and-down-arrow-buttons-on-jspinner
211  public void removeTinyArrows(Dimension targetSpinnerSize) {
212    Dimension d = getPreferredSize();
213    d.width = targetSpinnerSize.width;
214    setUI(new BasicSpinnerUI() {
215      @Override
216      protected Component createNextButton() {
217        return null;
218      }
219
220      @Override
221      protected Component createPreviousButton() {
222        return null;
223      }
224    });
225    setPreferredSize(d);
226  }
227
228  /**
229   * Get one of this component's local input maps. If it doesn't exist
230   * then create it and hook it in to the component.
231   * @return the specified input map
232   */
233  private InputMap getMyInputMap(int whichMap) {
234    return switch (whichMap) {
235      case WHEN_IN_FOCUSED_WINDOW -> {
236        if (inFocusedWindowInputMap == null) {
237          InputMap im = new ComponentInputMap(this);
238          im.setParent(getInputMap(WHEN_IN_FOCUSED_WINDOW));
239          setInputMap(WHEN_IN_FOCUSED_WINDOW, im);
240          inFocusedWindowInputMap = im;
241        }
242        yield inFocusedWindowInputMap;
243      }
244      case WHEN_ANCESTOR_OF_FOCUSED_COMPONENT -> {
245        if (ancestorOfFocusedComponentInputMap == null) {
246          InputMap im = new InputMap();
247          im.setParent(getInputMap(WHEN_ANCESTOR_OF_FOCUSED_COMPONENT));
248          setInputMap(WHEN_ANCESTOR_OF_FOCUSED_COMPONENT, im);
249          ancestorOfFocusedComponentInputMap = im;
250        }
251        yield ancestorOfFocusedComponentInputMap;
252      }
253      default -> null;
254    };
255  }
256
257  private InputMap inFocusedWindowInputMap;
258  private InputMap ancestorOfFocusedComponentInputMap;
259
260  /**
261   * Use the up/down arrow keys while this spinner's window is focused
262   * to adjust row number.
263   * @param enable true enables up/down keys when window has focus
264   */
265  public void setWindowUpDownKeysEnable(boolean enable) {
266    InputMap im = getMyInputMap(WHEN_IN_FOCUSED_WINDOW);
267    im.put(getKeyStroke(VK_UP, 0), enable ? "increment" : null);
268    im.put(getKeyStroke(VK_DOWN, 0), enable ? "decrement" : null);
269  }
270
271  /**
272   * Disable the up/down arrow keys for this spinner component.
273   * When disabling, window up/down keys are disabled
274   * using {@link #setWindowUpDownKeysEnable(boolean)}.
275   *
276   * @param enable true enables default
277   */
278  public void setUpDownKeysEnable(boolean enable) {
279    InputMap im = getMyInputMap(WHEN_ANCESTOR_OF_FOCUSED_COMPONENT);
280    im.put(getKeyStroke(VK_UP, 0), enable ? null : "none");
281    im.put(getKeyStroke(VK_DOWN, 0), enable ? null : "none");
282  }
283}
